author: DaiqingChen
body:
There is currently only the laminin trimers annotated to this term. 

**Add annotations for all gene products should be annotated under this term:** 
[260202_non collagenous component of basement membrane annotation QC.xlsx](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25134969/260202_non.collagenous.component.of.basement.membrane.annotation.QC.xlsx)


**Converted to Google spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/17wza0mcufyFVlyvl3_iCL8IWIHTfPxn818nYFxHSh54/edit?gid=2138464167#gid=2138464167

**About the file:** 
This list contains 48 non-collagenous genes that is active or located in the non-collagenous part of basement membrane. Among these 48 genes, 26 genes is active in the basement membrane, 22 is located in the basement membrane. The qualifier column is stating the status of how the relationship should be add. 
The last column is a checker of the location of protein, there are 26 genes only exist in basement membrane (BM), 22 genes exist both in the basement membrane and interstitial matrix (BM & IM). The qualifier column is stating the relationship of gene and the Non-collagenous component of basement membrane (GO:0140144) term.

All laminin related genes already exist in the term annotation through the laminin trimer child terms, no need to add again.

**Next step:**
Will run another QC of all annotations of basement membrane genes after adding all non-collagenous component of basement membrane.
